summary: Results of interrogation of data center employees
body: Report author: Clement Boxley After a lengthy interrogation, Robert Bruce, a junior data analyst, turned in his colleague Kyle Cunningham and stated that he was responsible for the section of the data center where the tetra-meth was found. He also claimed that there was a secret room inside the data center that Cunningham regularly visited, although Bruce didn't know its location. We made inquiries and learned that the first part of Robert's statement was true and that Kyle did indeed worked in that department. Since Kyle's employer is within our protective jurisdiction, I am requesting a warrant for his arrest and search to confirm or refute our theory of his possible guilt.
